title: 'It's cinematic': Gamers get first taste of 'Grand Theft Auto VI'
summary: Eager gamers in Miami sprang into action as the clock hit midnight on Thursday, diving into the highly anticipated launch of the latest installment of the "Grand Theft Auto" (GTA) video game.
